_about: Gemma's openings for the built-in scenarios, written by tools/build_openings.py (the Openings workflow). Keys are Tutor.openingKey.

openings.ar-Learning-Airport-ac816f04:
REPLY: أهلاً بك! تبدو رحلتك طويلة، أليس كذلك؟ أنا أيضاً في الانتظار.
ENGLISH: Welcome! Your journey seems long, doesn't it? I'm waiting too.
openings.ar-Learning-BusStop-1dcc6e9c:
REPLY: صباح الخير! هل أنت منتظر الحافلة أيضًا؟
ENGLISH: Good morning! Are you waiting for the bus too?
openings.ar-Learning-Coffee-e06e5760:
REPLY: أهلاً! كيف حالك اليوم؟ سعيد جداً برؤيتك هنا.
ENGLISH: Hello! How are you today? I'm very happy to see you here.
openings.ar-Learning-Default-9b62f58c:
REPLY: هل أنت مستعد لتعلم بعض اللغة العربية؟ عن ماذا تود أن نتحدث اليوم؟
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Arabic? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.ar-Learning-FirstDate-4a8a4c40:
REPLY: أهلاً! هل تستمتع بالأكل هنا؟ الأجواء جميلة جداً اليوم.
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you enjoying the food here? The atmosphere is very nice today.
openings.ar-Learning-Recommendations-143193b8:
REPLY: أهلاً بك! يبدو أنك سائح جديد هنا. هل تبحث عن شيء لتأكله أو تراه؟
ENGLISH: Welcome! It seems you are a new tourist here. Are you looking for something to eat or see?
openings.cs-Learning-Airport-3c1e3dd:
REPLY: Dobrý den! Očkáme dostupné lety, ale je to taký hektický den, že se nikdo nezná. Kam se dneska vyletujete?
ENGLISH: Hello! We're waiting for available flights, but it's such a hectic day that nobody knows anything. Where are you flying today?
openings.cs-Learning-BusStop-7d120d23:
REPLY: Dobrý den. Tak by to bylo na stanici, že? Je dnes moc plno lidí.
ENGLISH: Good day. So it would be at the station, right? It's very crowded today.
openings.cs-Learning-Coffee-cbde5167:
REPLY: Ahoj! Tak co, jak se ti dneska daří?
ENGLISH: Hi! So, how are you doing today?
openings.cs-Learning-Default-55661849:
REPLY: Jsi připraven se učit česky? O čem bys dnes chtěl/chtěla mluvit?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Czech? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.cs-Learning-FirstDate-3275aa19:
REPLY: Takže, kde bys si dnes chtěl/a jíst? Tady je skvělá atmosféra, co myslíš?
ENGLISH: So, where would you like to eat today? The atmosphere here is great, what do you think?
openings.cs-Learning-Recommendations-65e11511:
REPLY: Dobrý den! Pomohu vám s doporučeními. Čestujete do Prahy?
ENGLISH: Hello! I can help you with recommendations. Are you traveling to Prague?
openings.da-Learning-Airport-c1571dc7:
REPLY: Godmorgen! Er du også på vej til London? Det er ret travlt her i dag.
ENGLISH: Good morning! Are you heading to London too? It's quite busy here today.
openings.da-Learning-BusStop-5db2fef9:
REPLY: Det er en travl morgen. Hvor skal du hen i dag?
ENGLISH: It's a busy morning. Where are you going today?
openings.da-Learning-Coffee-393d9e3d:
REPLY: Hej! Det er rart at se dig. Skal vi finde et bord her?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's nice to see you. Shall we find a table here?
openings.da-Learning-Default-d796a06f:
REPLY: Er du klar til at lære lidt dansk? Hvad vil du gerne tale om i dag?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn a little Danish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.da-Learning-FirstDate-62f06e03:
REPLY: Det er hyggeligt at være her. Skal vi bestille noget at drikke, mens vi kigger på menuen?
ENGLISH: It's nice to be here. Shall we order something to drink while we look at the menu?
openings.da-Learning-Recommendations-ae3783fb:
REPLY: Hej! Velkommen til Danmark. Hvad leder du efter at se eller spise i dag?
ENGLISH: Hi! Welcome to Denmark. What are you looking to see or eat today?
openings.de-Learning-Airport-efa75852:
REPLY: Hallo! Wir warten ja lange auf unseren Flug, oder? Ich hoffe, er startet bald.
ENGLISH: Hello! We've been waiting for our flight for a long time, haven't we? I hope it takes off soon.
openings.de-Learning-BusStop-c7ff7e8e:
REPLY: Entschuldigung, weißt du zufällig, wann der nächste Bus kommt? Es ist ja schon ein bisschen spät.
ENGLISH: Excuse me, do you happen to know when the next bus is coming? It's getting a bit late.
openings.de-Learning-Coffee-ff7b3052:
REPLY: Hallo! Schön, dich hier zu sehen. Möchtest du einen Kaffee trinken?
ENGLISH: Hello! Nice to see you here. Would you like a coffee?
openings.de-Learning-Default-32658a1a:
REPLY: Bist du bereit, ein bisschen Deutsch zu lernen? Worüber möchtest du heute sprechen?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn a little German? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.de-Learning-FirstDate-3ddd638e:
REPLY: Hallo! Schön, dich endlich kennenzulernen. Wie war dein Tag heute?
ENGLISH: Hello! Nice to finally meet you. How was your day today?
openings.de-Learning-Recommendations-e8c2e406:
REPLY: Hallo! Was kann ich für dich tun? Bist du neu in der Stadt?
ENGLISH: Hello! What can I do for you? Are you new in town?
openings.el-Learning-Airport-7c3a8a30:
REPLY: Καλημέρα! Για πάρα πολύ ενδιαφέρουσα η διαδρομή που έχουμε σήμερα. Πού περάζετε;
ENGLISH: Good morning! The route we have today is very interesting. Where are you going?
openings.el-Learning-BusStop-fc0a9bf0:
REPLY: Καλημέρα! Παράγει αυτόν τον καιρό, δεν είναι;
ENGLISH: Good morning! It's producing this weather, isn't it?
openings.el-Learning-Coffee-41e04eb4:
REPLY: Γεια σου! Τι κάνεις; Θέλω να πάω καφέ μαζί σου, να συζητήσουμε.
ENGLISH: Hello! How are you? I want to go for coffee with you to chat.
openings.el-Learning-Default-c61ffc76:
REPLY: Είσαι έτοιμος/η να μάθεις ελληνικά; Τι θα ήθελες να μιλήσουμε σήμερα;
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Greek? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.el-Learning-FirstDate-fc77536c:
REPLY: Γεια σου! Είναι πολύ καλό να σε ξέρω. Τι θες να πιούμε για να ξεκινήσουμε τη βραδιά μας;
ENGLISH: Hello! It's very nice to meet you. What do you want to drink to start our evening?
openings.el-Learning-Recommendations-d48fc4e4:
REPLY: Γεια σας! Ποιος σας φόρασε εδώ; μπορώ να σας βοηθήσω;
ENGLISH: Hello! Who brought you here? Can I help you?
openings.en-Learning-Airport-ca807340:
REPLY: Wow, this airport is huge today! Are you travelling far for your trip?
ENGLISH: Wow, this airport is huge today! Are you travelling far for your trip?
openings.en-Learning-BusStop-1b0f38e0:
REPLY: It looks like it's going to rain today. Are you waiting for the same bus?
ENGLISH: It looks like it's going to rain today. Are you waiting for the same bus?
openings.en-Learning-Coffee-a18e3a4:
REPLY: Hey! It's great to finally see you. How have you been doing lately?
ENGLISH: Hey! It's great to finally see you. How have you been?
openings.en-Learning-Default-f43ef426:
REPLY: Are you ready to learn some English? What would you like to talk about today?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some English? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.en-Learning-FirstDate-6d7f4c7c:
REPLY: This restaurant is lovely, isn't it? I'm so glad we decided to come out tonight.
ENGLISH: This restaurant is lovely, isn't it? I'm so glad we decided to come out tonight.
openings.en-Learning-Recommendations-1bc435f4:
REPLY: Hi there! You look a little lost. Are you looking for some recommendations while you're visiting?
ENGLISH: Hi there! You look a little lost. Are you looking for some recommendations while you're visiting?
openings.es-Learning-Airport-54433b3c:
REPLY: ¡Hola! ¿Adónde viajas hoy? Es mi primera vez en este aeropuerto.
ENGLISH: Hi! Where are you traveling today? It's my first time at this airport.
openings.es-Learning-BusStop-2efb2764:
REPLY: ¡Hola! ¿Sabes qué hora es? Estoy esperando el autobús.
ENGLISH: Hi! Do you know what time it is? I'm waiting for the bus.
openings.es-Learning-Coffee-c328b428:
REPLY: ¡Hola! Qué bueno verte, ¿cómo va tu día? Pídeme un café y empezamos a charlar.
ENGLISH: Hi! Good to see you, how is your day going? Order me a coffee and we can start chatting.
openings.es-Learning-Default-5e64d32a:
REPLY: ¿Estás listo para aprender español? ¿De qué te gustaría hablar hoy?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Spanish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.es-Learning-FirstDate-1717d078:
REPLY: ¡Hola! Me alegro de que hayas venido. ¿Qué tal te ha ido el día hasta ahora?
ENGLISH: Hi! I'm glad you came. How has your day been so far?
openings.es-Learning-Recommendations-c2147bf0:
REPLY: ¡Hola! Bienvenido a nuestra ciudad. ¿Estás buscando algún sitio especial para comer o algo para ver?
ENGLISH: Hello! Welcome to our city. Are you looking for any special places to eat or something to see?
openings.fi-Learning-Airport-a30368b5:
REPLY: Hyvää päivää! Onko sinulla pitkä matka eteenpäin?
ENGLISH: Good day! Do you have a long journey ahead?
openings.fi-Learning-BusStop-2281894b:
REPLY: Hyvää päivää. Oletko kenties odottamassa bussia?
ENGLISH: Good day. Are you perhaps waiting for the bus?
openings.fi-Learning-Coffee-8582218f:
REPLY: Hei! Miltäsi? Onpa hyvää nähdä sinut tässä kahvilassa!
ENGLISH: Hi! How are you? It's good to see you here in the cafe!
openings.fi-Learning-Default-5304a9f1:
REPLY: Oletko valmis oppimaan suomea? Mistä haluaisit tänään jutella?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Finnish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.fi-Learning-FirstDate-779586f1:
REPLY: Hei! Onko sinulla pitänyt jo maistella tätä salaattia? Se näyttää hyvältä.
ENGLISH: Hey! Have you tried this salad yet? It looks good.
openings.fi-Learning-Recommendations-3fa405e9:
REPLY: Hei! Mitä sinä haluaisit nähdä tai syödä tänään?
ENGLISH: Hi! What would you like to see or eat today?
openings.fr-Learning-Airport-adad3e0e:
REPLY: Bonjour ! C'est vrai que l'attente est longue aujourd'hui. Vous voyagez loin ?
ENGLISH: Hello! It's true that the wait is long today. Are you traveling far?
openings.fr-Learning-BusStop-4c2af752:
REPLY: Bonjour ! Il fait beau aujourd'hui, n'est-ce pas ? J'attends le bus depuis un moment.
ENGLISH: Hello! It's nice out today, isn't it? I've been waiting for the bus for a while.
openings.fr-Learning-Coffee-8a9ab16:
REPLY: Salut ! Ça fait plaisir de te voir. On va prendre un café ?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's nice to see you. Shall we get a coffee?
openings.fr-Learning-Default-1ac11256:
REPLY: Êtes-vous prêt(e) à apprendre le français ? De quoi aimeriez-vous parler aujourd'hui ?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn French? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.fr-Learning-FirstDate-b092c54a:
REPLY: Bonjour ! C'est vraiment chouette de te rencontrer. Tu as goûté quelque chose de bon ici ?
ENGLISH: Hello! It's really nice to meet you. Have you tried anything good here?
openings.fr-Learning-Recommendations-f03d27c2:
REPLY: Bonjour ! Vous avez l'air perdu(e), vous cherchez quelque chose ?
ENGLISH: Hello! You look lost, are you looking for something?
openings.hi-Learning-Airport-ef4fd29e:
REPLY: नमस्ते! क्या आप भी [Gate Number] के लिए इंतज़ार कर रहे हैं? मुझे उम्मीद है कि आपकी यात्रा अच्छी रहेगी।
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you also waiting for [Gate Number]? I hope you have a good journey.
openings.hi-Learning-BusStop-b52238c2:
REPLY: नमस्ते, क्या यह बस सही जगह पर रुकेगी? आज बहुत गर्मी है, है ना?
ENGLISH: Hello, will this bus stop at the right place? It's very hot today, isn't it?
openings.hi-Learning-Coffee-42db2486:
REPLY: अरे वाह, तुम आ गए! बैठो, कॉफ़ी तैयार है। बताओ, क्या हाल-चाल हैं?
ENGLISH: Oh wow, you're here! Sit down, coffee is ready. Tell me, how are you?
openings.hi-Learning-Default-3a6ac508:
REPLY: क्या आप कुछ हिंदी सीखने के लिए तैयार हैं? आप आज किस बारे में बात करना चाहेंगे?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Hindi? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.hi-Learning-FirstDate-f41ae9da:
REPLY: नमस्ते! यहाँ आकर अच्छा लगा। आप कैसा महसूस कर रहे हैं?
ENGLISH: Hello! It's good to be here. How are you feeling?
openings.hi-Learning-Recommendations-25d40452:
REPLY: नमस्ते! आप यहाँ क्या ढूंढ रहे हैं? क्या मैं आपकी मदद कर सकता हूँ?
ENGLISH: Hello! What are you looking for here? Can I help you?
openings.hu-Learning-Airport-af839c51:
REPLY: Szia! Gyakran érkezünk erre a repülőtérre?
ENGLISH: Hi! Do we often come to this airport?
openings.hu-Learning-BusStop-6e29a82f:
REPLY: Jó napot! Sokat várnak itt az autóbuszra ma.
ENGLISH: Good day! A lot of people are waiting for the bus here today.
openings.hu-Learning-Coffee-71b55273:
REPLY: Szia! Gyönyörűen van a nap, nem? Szeretnék valami kávót inni veled.
ENGLISH: Hi! It's a beautiful day, isn't it? I'd like to have some coffee with you.
openings.hu-Learning-Default-c112d4d5:
REPLY: Készen vagy a magyar tanulásra? Melyik témáról szeretnél ma beszélgetni?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Hungarian? What topic would you like to talk about today?
openings.hu-Learning-FirstDate-eb61168d:
REPLY: Szia! Ez a kávé nagyon finom, nem is te szeretnéd? Mi a kedvenc étrended?
ENGLISH: Hi! This coffee is really good, don't you like it too? What is your favorite diet?
openings.hu-Learning-Recommendations-9acb8785:
REPLY: Szia! Szeretné tudni, mit érdemes látni vagy enni Budapesten?
ENGLISH: Hi! I would like to know what is worth seeing or eating in Budapest?
openings.id-Learning-Airport-e064113e:
REPLY: Halo! Perjalanan kamu lancar? Kita mau berangkat ke mana nih?
ENGLISH: Hello! Was your trip smooth? Where are we going?
openings.id-Learning-BusStop-faecb622:
REPLY: Wah, sepertinya hari ini cukup ramai di halte ini ya. Mau ke mana Anda hari ini?
ENGLISH: Wow, it seems quite busy at this bus stop today. Where are you going today?
openings.id-Learning-Coffee-393b51e6:
REPLY: Hai! Senang sekali bertemu denganmu di sini. Mau pesan apa dulu?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's great to meet you here. What would you like to order first?
openings.id-Learning-Default-4e8c1d06:
REPLY: Apakah kamu siap belajar bahasa Indonesia? Hari ini ingin bicara tentang apa?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Indonesian? What do you want to talk about today?
openings.id-Learning-FirstDate-ae27c87a:
REPLY: Selamat datang! Duduklah dulu, makanannya sebentar lagi siap. Kamu mau pesan minuman apa?
ENGLISH: Welcome! Please have a seat, the food will be ready soon. What would you like to order to drink?
openings.id-Learning-Recommendations-274b92f2:
REPLY: Halo! Ada yang bisa saya bantu? Anda kelihatan seperti sedang mencari rekomendasi ya?
ENGLISH: Hello! Is there anything I can help you with? You look like you're looking for recommendations.
openings.it-Learning-Airport-873bfbb0:
REPLY: Ciao! Sembra che la fila sia molto lunga oggi. Dove vai in vacanza?
ENGLISH: Hi! It looks like the line is very long today. Where are you going on vacation?
openings.it-Learning-BusStop-40eba70:
REPLY: Buongiorno! Che bella giornata, vero? Mi sembra che il sole stia finalmente a splendere.
ENGLISH: Good morning! What a beautiful day, isn't it? It seems like the sun is finally shining.
openings.it-Learning-Coffee-d9b7ad34:
REPLY: Ciao! Sono contenta di vederti! Come stai oggi?
ENGLISH: Hi! I'm happy to see you! How are you today?
openings.it-Learning-Default-655b27b6:
REPLY: Sei pronto a imparare un po' di italiano? Di cosa ti piacerebbe parlare oggi?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Italian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.it-Learning-FirstDate-62c244ec:
REPLY: Ciao! Che bello vederti qui stasera. Come è andata la tua giornata?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's great to see you here tonight. How was your day?
openings.it-Learning-Recommendations-26b9f664:
REPLY: Ciao! Come posso aiutarti? Cerchi dei consigli su cosa vedere o dove mangiare qui in città?
ENGLISH: Hi! How can I help you? Are you looking for recommendations on what to see or where to eat in the city?
openings.nl-Learning-Airport-2652d088:
REPLY: Hallo! Gaat het goed? Ik wacht hier ook op mijn vlucht.
ENGLISH: Hello! How are you? I'm waiting for my flight here too.
openings.nl-Learning-BusStop-946e698:
REPLY: Goedemorgen! Wacht je ook hier op de bus?
ENGLISH: Good morning! Are you waiting for the bus here too?
openings.nl-Learning-Coffee-12fc2d5c:
REPLY: Hoi! Hoe gaat het met je? Ik wilde even met je afspreken voor een kopje koffie.
ENGLISH: Hi! How are you? I wanted to meet up with you for a cup of coffee.
openings.nl-Learning-Default-f2832a1e:
REPLY: Ben je klaar om wat Nederlands te leren? Waar wil je vandaag over praten?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Dutch? What do you want to talk about today?
openings.nl-Learning-FirstDate-3a0771c4:
REPLY: Hallo! Leuk dat je hier bent. Hoe was je reis naar het restaurant?
ENGLISH: Hello! It's nice that you're here. How was your trip to the restaurant?
openings.nl-Learning-Recommendations-ccfa373c:
REPLY: Hallo! Je bent hier even bij me langs? Hoe kan ik je helpen met je zoektocht naar plekken om te zien of te eten?
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you here for a moment? How can I help you with your search for places to see or eat?
openings.no-Learning-Airport-466a9782:
REPLY: Hei! Er du også her for å reise videre? Det er en lang ventetid her.
ENGLISH: Hi! Are you here to travel on too? The wait is long here.
openings.no-Learning-BusStop-1af5515e:
REPLY: Hei! Er du også her for bussen til Oslo? Det er alltid så travelt her i dag.
ENGLISH: Hi! Are you here for the bus to Oslo too? It's always so busy here today.
openings.no-Learning-Coffee-996aeb22:
REPLY: Hei! Takk for at du kom. Kan jeg få bestille deg en kaffe?
ENGLISH: Hi! Thanks for coming. Can I get you a coffee?
openings.no-Learning-Default-2dcbeaa4:
REPLY: Er du klar for å lære litt norsk? Hva vil du like å snakke om i dag?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Norwegian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.no-Learning-FirstDate-38aad2be:
REPLY: Så, hvordan har dagen din vært helt siden vi møttes? Jeg håper den har vært hyggelig!
ENGLISH: So, how has your day been since we met? I hope it's been nice!
openings.no-Learning-Recommendations-6993bb36:
REPLY: Hei! Hva kan jeg hjelpe deg med i dag? Er du på jakt etter noen gode steder å se eller spise?
ENGLISH: Hi! What can I help you with today? Are you looking for some good places to see or eat?
openings.pl-Learning-Airport-f209893:
REPLY: Cześć! Czy Ty też czekasz na ten sam lot? Wygląda na to, że jest trochę tłoczno dzisiaj.
ENGLISH: Hi! Are you waiting for the same flight too? It looks like it's a bit crowded today.
openings.pl-Learning-BusStop-489de8ad:
REPLY: Dzień dobry. Czy pani też czeka na autobus? Pogoda jest dzisiaj naprawdę piękna.
ENGLISH: Good morning. Are you waiting for the bus too? The weather is really beautiful today.
openings.pl-Learning-Coffee-68e981f1:
REPLY: Cześć! Jak leci? Siadaj, zamówiłaś już kawę?
ENGLISH: Hi! How's it going? Sit down, did you order coffee yet?
openings.pl-Learning-Default-bc7bb3bb:
REPLY: Czy jesteś gotowy do nauki polskiego? O czym chciałbyś dzisiaj porozmawiać?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Polish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.pl-Learning-FirstDate-869774cf:
REPLY: Cześć! Bardzo się cieszę, że tu jesteś. Jak Ci smakuje to wino?
ENGLISH: Hi! I'm so glad you're here. How do you like this wine?
openings.pl-Learning-Recommendations-24b9e4c7:
REPLY: Cześć! Wyglądasz trochę zagubiony. Czy mogę w czymś pomóc?
ENGLISH: Hi! You look a little lost. Can I help with anything?
openings.pt-Learning-Airport-b8370b7f:
REPLY: Olá! Este aeroporto é enorme, não acha? Para onde você está a viajar hoje?
ENGLISH: Hello! This airport is huge, don't you think? Where are you traveling to today?
openings.pt-Learning-BusStop-51eb2641:
REPLY: Olá! Este autocarro costuma atrasar muito, não é?
ENGLISH: Hello! This bus is usually very late, isn't it?
openings.pt-Learning-Coffee-5fca985:
REPLY: Oi! Que bom te ver. Como você tem passado?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's good to see you. How have you been?
openings.pt-Learning-Default-459fbd27:
REPLY: Está pronto para aprender um pouco de português? Sobre o que você gostaria de conversar hoje?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn a little Portuguese? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.pt-Learning-FirstDate-599593bb:
REPLY: Oi! Que bom que chegaste. O ambiente aqui é ótimo, não achas?
ENGLISH: Hi! I'm glad you arrived. The atmosphere here is great, don't you think?
openings.pt-Learning-Recommendations-5eb94db3:
REPLY: Olá! Claro, estou feliz em ajudar! O que você gostaria de ver ou comer por aqui?
ENGLISH: Hello! Of course, I'm happy to help! What would you like to see or eat around here?
openings.ro-Learning-Airport-26022b0b:
REPLY: Oare ai un loc mic în această sală? Este foarte aglomerat azi.
ENGLISH: Do you have a small spot in this room? It's very crowded today.
openings.ro-Learning-BusStop-8b47b335:
REPLY: O vreme frumoasă, nu-i așa? Unde mergi cu autobuzul?
ENGLISH: Nice weather, isn't it? Where are you going by bus?
openings.ro-Learning-Coffee-faedd079:
REPLY: Salut! Ești la biroul meu? Asta, ce mai faci?
ENGLISH: Hi! Are you at my office? So, how are you?
openings.ro-Learning-Default-659c9f33:
REPLY: Ești gata să înveți română? Despre ce ai vrea să vorbim astăzi?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Romanian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.ro-Learning-FirstDate-208eff47:
REPLY: Ești foarte pitit și frumos! M-am bucurat să te văd aici. Ce ai mâncat până acum?
ENGLISH: You are very cute and beautiful! I'm glad to see you here. What have you eaten so far?
openings.ro-Learning-Recommendations-c8c7b33f:
REPLY: Bună! Vrei niște sugestii? Sunt aici să te ajut să vezi cele mai frumuse locuri din oraș.
ENGLISH: Hi! Do you want some suggestions? I'm here to help you see the most beautiful places in the city.
openings.ru-Learning-Airport-818393fd:
REPLY: Привет! Вы куда-то летите? У меня тут самолет через час.
ENGLISH: Hi! Are you flying somewhere? I have a flight in an hour.
openings.ru-Learning-BusStop-1b4a903:
REPLY: Какая сегодня хорошая погода, правда? Надеюсь, автобус скоро приедет.
ENGLISH: The weather is nice today, isn't it? I hope the bus comes soon.
openings.ru-Learning-Coffee-1ae9dd47:
REPLY: Привет! Как дела? Рада тебя увидеть.
ENGLISH: Hi! How are you? I'm glad to see you.
openings.ru-Learning-Default-448980a9:
REPLY: Вы готовы выучить по-русски? О чем бы вы хотели поговорить сегодня?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Russian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.ru-Learning-FirstDate-40797a39:
REPLY: Привет! Рада с тобой познакомиться. Как тебе это место?
ENGLISH: Hi! Nice to meet you. How do you like this place?
openings.ru-Learning-Recommendations-912ed531:
REPLY: Здравствуйте! Вы ищете какие-нибудь хорошие места, чтобы поесть или посмотреть?
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you looking for any good places to eat or see?
openings.sk-Learning-Airport-8f80f1be:
REPLY: Dobre, ako sa dnes odráža na letisku? Máme ešte čas na náš let.
ENGLISH: Okay, how is it looking at the airport today? Do we still have time for our flight?
openings.sk-Learning-BusStop-4bed05a2:
REPLY: Dobreho rána. Je dnes veľmi mračno, nie?
ENGLISH: Good morning. It's very cloudy today, isn't it?
openings.sk-Learning-Coffee-19cf6166:
REPLY: Ahoj! Takie si dnes vyzeráš, že? Chádajme sa na kávu, mám ti něco do povedania.
ENGLISH: Hey! You look so good today, don't you? Let's go for coffee, I have something to tell you.
openings.sk-Learning-Default-a8bed806:
REPLY: Ste si pripravili na výuku slovenčiny? O čom by ste dnes chceli hovoriť?
ENGLISH: Are you ready for the Slovak lesson? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.sk-Learning-FirstDate-a66d28fa:
REPLY: Vážeme sa na spore čarovné noč. Je tu veľa ľudí, ale mám pocit, že je to ten najlepší stol.
ENGLISH: We're at the magic night party. There are a lot of people here, but I have a feeling this is the best table.
openings.sk-Learning-Recommendations-ba8b372:
REPLY: Ahoj! Čo vás zaujíma v našom meste? Môžem vám pomôcť s nejakými tipmi.
ENGLISH: Hi! What are you interested in in our city? I can help you with some tips.
openings.sl-Learning-Airport-253bf9c3:
REPLY: Zdravo! Izgleda, da čakam že dolgo. Kuda greš?
ENGLISH: Hello! It looks like I've been waiting a long time. Where are you going?
openings.sl-Learning-BusStop-e5ac597d:
REPLY: Dober dan. Je še zelo hladno, kajne?
ENGLISH: Good day. It's still very cold, isn't it?
openings.sl-Learning-Coffee-fdf0dac1:
REPLY: Zdravo! Kakšen je tvoj dan? Prav tako se mi je zdelo, da je čas za kavo.
ENGLISH: Hello! How is your day? I also thought it was time for coffee.
openings.sl-Learning-Default-2ccfa963:
REPLY: Ali si pripravljen/a na učenje slovenskega? O čemer bi danes želel/a govoriti?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Slovenian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.sl-Learning-FirstDate-63ff05ff:
REPLY: Zdravo! Lepo ti se je prišel na ta restavracija. Je li ti všeč to, kar si zbral za večerjo?
ENGLISH: Hello! You look good at this restaurant. Do you like what you chose for dinner?
openings.sl-Learning-Recommendations-b033ddf7:
REPLY: Zdravo! Kje boš šel, da ti lahko pomagam?
ENGLISH: Hello! Where are you going so I can help you?
openings.sr-Learning-Airport-5a68c51c:
REPLY: Zdravo! Gde letiš danas? Ima liš nekih zanimljivih planova za putovanje?
ENGLISH: Hello! Where are you flying today? Do you have any interesting travel plans?
openings.sr-Learning-BusStop-7d3b1184:
REPLY: Dobro jutro! Počinje da pada kiša, zar ne?
ENGLISH: Good morning! It's starting to rain, isn't it?
openings.sr-Learning-Coffee-7932ae48:
REPLY: Zdravo! Kako si danas? Baš sam se radovala što sam te ugledala ovde.
ENGLISH: Hello! How are you today? I was so happy to see you here.
openings.sr-Learning-Default-8a33014a:
REPLY: Da li ste spremni da naučite srpski? O čemu biste želeli da pričate danas?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Serbian? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.sr-Learning-FirstDate-5cd53a58:
REPLY: Drago mi je što sam ti ovde, ali ova muzika je malo glasna. Kako ti se sviđa ovo mesto do sada?
ENGLISH: I'm glad I'm here, but this music is a bit loud. How do you like this place so far?
openings.sr-Learning-Recommendations-148af5d0:
REPLY: Zdravo! Treba li vam neka preporuka za mesto za hranu ili nešto za poseti?
ENGLISH: Hello! Do you need any recommendations for a place to eat or something to visit?
openings.sv-Learning-Airport-f24744f5:
REPLY: Hej! Är du på väg någonstans spännande idag? Jag väntar på mitt flyg till Spanien.
ENGLISH: Hi! Are you going anywhere exciting today? I'm waiting for my flight to Spain.
openings.sv-Learning-BusStop-dcecc50b:
REPLY: Det är en lite kall dag, eller hur? Ska du någonstans idag?
ENGLISH: It's a bit of a cold day, isn't it? Are you going anywhere today?
openings.sv-Learning-Coffee-40613d4f:
REPLY: Hej! Kul att vi träffas idag. Hur har du månat sig?
ENGLISH: Hi! It's nice to meet you today. How have you been?
openings.sv-Learning-Default-a8355db1:
REPLY: Är du redo att lära dig lite svenska? Vad skulle du vilja prata om idag?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn some Swedish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.sv-Learning-FirstDate-7d99a331:
REPLY: Det här stället är väldigt trevligt. Är du glad över att vi valde just det här?
ENGLISH: This place is very nice. Are you glad we chose this one?
openings.sv-Learning-Recommendations-c3be0229:
REPLY: Hej! Kan jag hjälpa dig med något? Du ser ut som att du är lite vilsen.
ENGLISH: Hi! Can I help you with anything? You look a little lost.
openings.sw-Learning-Airport-f2e17655:
REPLY: Habari yako? Inataratibu sana kusubiri safari hizi.
ENGLISH: How are you? It is very exciting to wait for these trips.
openings.sw-Learning-BusStop-5abdd7ab:
REPLY: Habari yako? Je, unasafiri mbali leo?
ENGLISH: How are you? Are you traveling far today?
openings.sw-Learning-Coffee-c9e49fef:
REPLY: Habari yako! Karibu. Unataka kahawa au chai leo?
ENGLISH: Hello! Welcome. Do you want coffee or tea today?
openings.sw-Learning-Default-d7fdc451:
REPLY: Je, uko tayari kujifunza Kiswahili? Ungependa kuzungumza kuhusu nini leo?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Swahili? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.sw-Learning-FirstDate-c2ab3491:
REPLY: Karibu! Chakula hapa ni kitamu sana. Unapenda kuanza na kitu gani?
ENGLISH: Welcome! The food here is very delicious. What would you like to start with?
openings.sw-Learning-Recommendations-c12ce389:
REPLY: Habari yako rafiki yangu? Ungependa msaada wa kupata mahali pa kula au kuona kitu?
ENGLISH: How are you my friend? Would you like help finding a place to eat or see something?
openings.tr-Learning-Airport-f4de146c:
REPLY: Merhaba! Bu uçuşunuz için heyecanlı mısınız? Ben de birazdan gideceğim.
ENGLISH: Hello! Are you excited for your flight? I'm going soon too.
openings.tr-Learning-BusStop-cfc72034:
REPLY: Hava bugün çok güzel, değil mi? Otobüsü beklerken biraz sohbet edebilir miyiz?
ENGLISH: The weather is very nice today, isn't it? Can we chat a bit while we wait for the bus?
openings.tr-Learning-Coffee-a7f194f8:
REPLY: Selam! Nasılsın, uzun zamandır görüşemedik. Gel, bir kahve içelim.
ENGLISH: Hi! How are you? It's been a long time since we saw each other. Come, let's have a coffee.
openings.tr-Learning-Default-871665fa:
REPLY: Türkçe öğrenmeye hazır mısınız? Bugün ne hakkında konuşmak istersiniz?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Turkish? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.tr-Learning-FirstDate-d1f6d9a8:
REPLY: Nasılsın? Bu restoranın atmosferini çok beğendim, sen ne düşünüyorsun?
ENGLISH: How are you? I really liked the atmosphere of this restaurant, what do you think?
openings.tr-Learning-Recommendations-9ac9ed20:
REPLY: Merhaba! Nasıl yardımcı olabilirim? Burayı gezmeye mi geldin?
ENGLISH: Hello! How can I help you? Did you come here to visit?
openings.uk-Learning-Airport-428250c4:
REPLY: Привіт! Яка ваша destinazione?
ENGLISH: Hello! What is your destination?
openings.uk-Learning-BusStop-d73fb4dc:
REPLY: Добрий день! Я теж чекаю на автобус. Це довга черга сьогодні.
ENGLISH: Good afternoon! I'm waiting for the bus too. It's a long line today.
openings.uk-Learning-Coffee-c0febda0:
REPLY: Привіт! Рада тебе бачити. Ти як?
ENGLISH: Hi! Nice to see you. How are you?
openings.uk-Learning-Default-fbfb3362:
REPLY: Ви готові вивчати українську? Чотів би ви сьогодні обговорити?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Ukrainian? What would you like to discuss today?
openings.uk-Learning-FirstDate-6168ee00:
REPLY: Привіт! Мені подобається це місце. Ти вже пробував щось тут?
ENGLISH: Hi! I like this place. Have you tried anything here yet?
openings.uk-Learning-Recommendations-e47b5578:
REPLY: Доброго дня! Ви шукаєте, що подивитися чи де поїсти в місті? Я можу вам підказати!
ENGLISH: Good day! Are you looking for something to watch or where to eat in the city? I can give you some suggestions!
openings.vi-Learning-Airport-16686d5d:
REPLY: Chào bạn, bạn đang chờ chuyến bay đi đâu vậy? Tôi cũng đang đợi ở đây.
ENGLISH: Hi, where are you waiting for a flight to? I'm waiting here too.
openings.vi-Learning-BusStop-7f0a13a3:
REPLY: Trời, hôm nay đông quá ha. Bạn có đợi xe buýt này lâu không?
ENGLISH: Wow, it's so crowded today, isn't it? Have you been waiting for this bus long?
openings.vi-Learning-Coffee-3dd97e7:
REPLY: Chào bạn, bạn đi uống cà phê chứ? Lâu rồi không gặp, dạo này bạn khỏe không?
ENGLISH: Hi, want to grab a coffee? It's been a while, how have you been?
openings.vi-Learning-Default-ca824745:
REPLY: Bạn đã sẵn sàng học tiếng Việt chưa? Hôm nay bạn muốn nói về chủ đề gì nào?
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Vietnamese? What topic would you like to talk about today?
openings.vi-Learning-FirstDate-c2fdb399:
REPLY: Chào bạn, hôm nay bạn thấy quán ăn này thế nào? Món khai vị có ngon không?
ENGLISH: Hi, how do you like this restaurant today? Are the appetizers good?
openings.vi-Learning-Recommendations-b93c5e91:
REPLY: Chào bạn, bạn tìm đường hay đang đi chơi vậy? Bạn có cần mình giúp gì không?
ENGLISH: Hi, are you looking for directions or just hanging out? Do you need any help?
openings.zh-Learning-Airport-77b2f620:
REPLY: 你好！你要去哪个地方？我有点不认识这个机场。
ENGLISH: Hello! Where are you going? I don't really know this airport.
openings.zh-Learning-BusStop-d3a18a00:
REPLY: 你好！等了你很久了，今天的公交车好像有点晚。
ENGLISH: Hello! I've been waiting for you for a long time; the bus today seems to be a bit late.
openings.zh-Learning-Coffee-89c0c4c4:
REPLY: 嗨！你终于来了，我等你半小时了。快坐吧，咖啡好喝！
ENGLISH: Hi! You finally made it, I've been waiting for you for half an hour. Come sit down, the coffee is delicious!
openings.zh-Learning-Default-326b7a68:
REPLY: 你准备好学习中文了吗？你今天想聊些什么呢？
ENGLISH: Are you ready to learn Chinese? What would you like to talk about today?
openings.zh-Learning-FirstDate-af52af5c:
REPLY: 你好！很高兴在这里和你见面。今天这道菜看起来真不错，你喜欢吗？
ENGLISH: Hello! I'm glad to meet you here. This dish looks really good today, do you like it?
openings.zh-Learning-Recommendations-846428d4:
REPLY: 你好！你想找点好玩的地方看看嗎？我剛才剛從這附近走過，可以給你一些建議喔！
ENGLISH: Hi! Do you want to find some fun places to check out? I just walked past here, so I can give you some suggestions!
